company.name: Knight Eyes Security Services
company.subTagline: Security guarding, housekeeping, manpower outsourcing and rigorous on-the-job training — led by ex-servicemen who take vigilance seriously.

leadership.name: Namdev Bhanudas Doke
leadership.bio: Retired from the Indian Army. Brings decades of military discipline and leadership to KESS's operations and training standards.

leadership.name: Mahesh Doke
leadership.bio: A well-established entrepreneur in security and housekeeping services, and a recognised name in the landscaping domain across Maharashtra over the past five years.

about.mission: To build a strong bond with organisations wanting to build a support system and improve their present structure, by providing perpetual consultancy and recruitment of staff or labour — permanent, contractual, skilled, or unskilled.
about.vision: To be the best security consultant and employee management partner as a way of life in business organisations and industries.
about.description: Knight Eyes Security Services was founded 10 years ago to provide the best corporate service in its field, specialising in manpower services (both skilled and unskilled), security services, and housekeeping services to public and professional sectors.

whyKess.title: Ex-Servicemen Leadership
whyKess.description: Governed and directly guided by retired Indian Army personnel, bringing military precision and uncompromised discipline to every posting.

whyKess.title: PSARA Licensed
whyKess.description: Fully licensed under the Private Security Agencies (Regulation) Act, Maharashtra.

whyKess.title: Structured Training
whyKess.description: Every guard goes through physical training, firefighting basics and martial arts — not just a uniform and a chair.

whyKess.title: Zero Tolerance Policy
whyKess.description: Strict standards on integrity, confidentiality, punctuality and sobriety, enforced without exception.

whyKess.title: A Decade of Track Record
whyKess.description: Ten years of consistent service across corporate, residential and institutional sites.

whyKess.title: Statutory Compliance
whyKess.description: Full PF and ESI compliance for every deployed employee, with clean documentation for audits.

services.title: Security Guarding
services.description: Trained, disciplined security personnel for commercial, residential and industrial premises, on rotating or fixed shifts.

services.title: Housekeeping Services
services.description: Professional housekeeping and facility upkeep for offices, townships and commercial spaces.

services.title: Manpower Outsourcing
services.description: Data entry operators, office assistants, receptionists, peons, courier boys and casual labour — fully compliant staffing.

services.title: On-the-Job Training Programme
services.description: Physical training, firefighting basics, mount-dismount control & command, and martial arts training led by a black belt Wu-Shu Kung Fu instructor.

services.title: VIP Protection & Bodyguards
services.description: Dedicated close-protection personnel trained in mount-dismount control and command procedures.

services.title: Crowd Control & Event Security
services.description: Trained personnel for events, ceremonies and crowd management scenarios.
